svg.title: Galim / persistent online tables
svg.desc: HTTP polling · one authoritative writer · October 2026 Players and TV viewers: React / Vite clients · HTTP polling every 800 ms, Players: Google session + their own hand, TV: revocable link; tiles revealed only at hand end. Express + shared TypeScript engine: Validate identity, seat, revision and move, Run bots, presence timers and spectator projection, Serialize operations; acknowledge after DB commit. PostgreSQL · persistent volume: Profiles, sessions and room snapshots, Accepted request IDs and completed match history, Writer ownership, ranking and event redemption
svg.text: HTTP polling · one authoritative writer · October 2026
React / Vite clients · HTTP polling every 800 ms
Players: Google session + their own hand
TV: revocable link; tiles revealed only at hand end
Validate identity, seat, revision and move
Run bots, presence timers and spectator projection
Serialize operations; acknowledge after DB commit
Accepted request IDs and completed match history
Writer ownership, ranking and event redemption
Restart: restore committed state and original deadlines.
TV requests do not keep an abandoned table alive.
Local single-player still executes moves in the browser.
